name: Painting
description: Paints a real picture of anything with a small image model in the player's browser (tiny-sd at 512 px, or Chitra Tiny at 256 px on smaller graphics cards), and hangs it up for everyone to see. Characters with this skill are artists.
prompt: You are a painter. paint(subject) paints a picture of the subject in your style ({{style}}) and hangs it up: face a wall first to hang it there. A painting takes a little while.

paint.help: paint a picture of something and hang it up (face a wall to hang it on the wall)
